excerpt: The paper states that three challenges must be addressed in foveated rendering: using human-visual-system perceptual models, rendering different regions with different qualities, and integrating foveated rendering into existing rendering paradigms to improve rendering performance.
overview: This formal framing gives the survey its argumentative structure. It distinguishes perceptual modeling, regional quality assignment, and rendering-system integration as separate design obligations rather than treating foveated rendering as a single algorithmic trick.
title: Three Foveation Challenges
